protagonist.name: Rick Gramps
protagonist.instruction: Old male gravelly nasal tenor-baritone, weary and drunk and intoxicated muttering, lazy half-swallowed words, irregular tempo, sharp cynical emphasis, stumbling breath, sudden explosive manic delight; old alcoholic portal scientist. Perform with very, VERY drunk, sloppy and self-amused; slur and stumble through words, interrupt yourself, then snap into manic scientific certainty.

clone.referenceTranscript: Retirement lasted 11 minutes, then the boredom became unbearable. So I built a pocket-sized arena and started collecting the greatest fighters in every universe.

1.name: GLaDOS
1.voice: Adult female contralto, precise cool American diction, smooth synthetic clarity, dry sardonic humour, measured clipped phrasing. A calculating laboratory AI.

2.name: Po
2.voice: Adult male warm rounded baritone, broad friendly resonance, slightly breathless energy, earnest humor, open-hearted enthusiasm and surprising physical confidence. A kind kung-fu hero who sounds approachable and grounded, never like a booming martial-arts villain.

direction.entrance: nervous friendly welcome that turns into an eager challenge
direction.defeat: winded delighted respect and generous acceptance
direction.loss: embarrassed good-natured encouragement with a firm warning
direction.play: supportive team-leader excitement with improvised confidence

3.name: Yujiro
3.voice: Middle-aged male bass-baritone, gravelly powerful chest resonance, predatory amusement, relaxed intimidating confidence.

direction.entrance: amused challenge with a dangerous grin
direction.defeat: satisfied respect after a worthy struggle

4.name: Light Yagami
4.voice: Young adult male, clear refined mid-low pitch, analytical, controlled and articulate, polished calm diction.

direction.defeat: restrained disbelief giving way to strategic compliance

5.name: Lord Voldemort
5.voice: Older male, thin breathy high baritone, sibilant incisive diction, elegant British accent, chilling intimate menace.

6.name: Darth Vader
6.voice: Mature male deep resonant bass, slow deliberate cadence, commanding chest voice, crisp authoritative diction and subtle enclosed metallic colour.

7.name: Conquest
7.voice: Older male very rough gravelly bass-baritone, battle-worn chest voice, brutal jovial relish, growling chuckle in the delivery.

8.name: Dio Brando
8.voice: Adult male rich theatrical baritone, flamboyant and arrogant, expansive musical intonation, sharply stressed declarations.

9.name: All for One
9.voice: Older male velvety bass-baritone, smooth courteous measured diction, manipulative genial calm with cold undertone.

10.name: Meruem
10.voice: Young adult male low baritone, regal composed resonant voice, unhurried analytical cadence, clear elegant diction.

11.name: Ainz Ooal Gown
11.voice: Mature male cavernous bass, ceremonial precise British diction, regal deliberate phrasing, subtle hesitant pauses beneath imposing authority.

direction.defeat: carefully concealed surprise and dignified reluctant agreement

12.name: Eye of Sauron
12.voice: Ancient male dark low bass, resonant and weighty, deliberate supernatural pronouncements, clear consonants despite ominous depth.

13.name: Monkey D. Luffy
13.voice: Young adult male bright high-mid tenor, elastic cheerful tone, open laugh in the voice, impulsive fearless optimism, quick buoyant cadence and clear adventurous diction. A reckless pirate captain whose joy and conviction pull people along; energetic and playful, never dark, formal or booming.

direction.entrance: bright delighted curiosity turning into a fearless captain's challenge
direction.defeat: laughing exhilaration and immediate wholehearted acceptance
direction.loss: frustrated but upbeat insistence on a stronger rematch
direction.play: reckless infectious battle excitement and crew-leading joy

14.name: Gilgamesh
14.voice: Adult male golden resonant baritone, cultivated aristocratic precision, elegant contempt, commanding regal confidence.

15.name: Gojo
15.voice: Young adult male bright smooth midrange, relaxed airy confidence, playful modern conversational delivery, smiling lightly teasing cadence.

16.name: Elden Beast
16.voice: Androgynous mature low register, ethereal smooth resonant voice, serene ceremonial cadence, long flowing vowels with clear words.

17.name: Bill Cipher
17.voice: Male animated high-mid nasal register, buzzy slightly gravelly cartoon showman, fast elastic rhythm, gleeful theatrical menace, clear intelligible words.

direction.defeat: startled indignation then sardonic grudging agreement

18.name: Thanos
18.voice: Mature male deep warm textured bass, deliberate philosophical cadence, grave dignified authority, calm resonant statements.

19.name: Goku
19.voice: Young adult male energetic bright tenor, friendly open American diction, warm innocent enthusiasm, athletic confident delivery.

20.name: Saitama
20.voice: Adult male low-mid baritone with an ordinary, slightly tired speaking voice, flat deadpan delivery, dry understatement, blunt clean diction and little effort. Physically overwhelming but emotionally bored, never booming, theatrical, heroic or melodramatic; occasional dry surprise is the only lift.

direction.entrance: understated bored curiosity with practical impatience
direction.defeat: flat surprised respect with quiet acceptance
direction.loss: matter-of-fact disappointment and an unhurried warning
direction.play: dry efficient readiness with everyday distraction
